criteria.requirement: An actual 3D Norb Studio homepage presents interactive floating abstract shapes in a full-screen hero.
criteria.action: Open the homepage and use its offered floating-shape interaction.
criteria.expected: A full-screen Norb Studio hero contains floating abstract 3D shapes that visibly respond.

criteria.requirement: A 3D loading screen shows a rotating cube, with exactly one letter on each face, conveying and repeating Norb Studio's name as it spins, and transitions into the page.
criteria.action: Reload and observe the loading cube before, during and after its rotation.
criteria.expected: Each visible cube face has one letter; the spinning presentation conveys Norb Studio and transitions to the homepage.

criteria.requirement: Scrolling reveals a readable studio narrative with smooth visual transitions.
criteria.action: Scroll through the narrative in both directions.
criteria.expected: The studio story and goals remain readable through continuous visual transitions.

criteria.requirement: A vertical artwork carousel forms a recognizable 3D helix and responds to scrolling.
criteria.action: Scroll through the artwork gallery and reverse direction.
criteria.expected: Artwork follows a vertical 3D helix and the carousel rotates with scrolling.

criteria.requirement: The contact form has interactive 3D treatment, with field hover/focus feedback and usable inputs.
criteria.action: Hover the contact fields, focus them and enter sample text.
criteria.expected: The 3D-treated fields animate and change color on hover while remaining usable.

scenarios.instruction: Observe the loading-to-hero sequence and inspect floating shapes from pointer movement.
Scroll through the narrative and helix; inspect multiple artworks, then enter contact fields.
Reverse the scroll, revisit the gallery and move focus through the form; check that page states remain usable.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
